caption:
Most deals aren't lost to price. They're lost to silence.

Picture it. Someone needs what you sell. They fill in your form at 2pm. You're on a job, hands full, phone in the truck.

You call back at 7pm. They already booked someone else.

They didn't choose a better company. They chose the one that answered.

This is the cheapest problem in your business to fix and the one almost nobody measures. Response time doesn't show up on any report your agency sends you. It shows up in revenue you never knew you lost.

Three questions worth asking yourself today:
→ How long does a lead actually wait for a reply?
→ Who is responsible when you're busy?
→ What happens to the ones who don't answer the first call?

If you can't answer those, that's where your money is going.
